name: Gufic Biosciences Limited
remarksWeb: 1. Pursuant to the saction of Scheme of Amlagamation of Gufic Lifesciences Private Limited (Transferor Company) with the Company and their respective shareholders and creditors by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai bench and Ahmedabad bench, the Board of Directors of the Company approved the allotment of ,91,14,506 equity share of FV Re.1/- each to the Shareholders of Transferor Company. Accordingly, the paid up share capital of the Company increased from Rs. 7,78,30,000/- divided into 7,78,30,000 equity shares of FV of Re. 1/- each to Rs. 9,69,44,506/- divided into 9,69,44,506 equity shares of FV of Re.1/- each.   2. The Company shall initiate the process for issue of the aforementioned equity shares to the shareholder of the Transferor Company, within the stipulated time frame, which shall be followed by the application of listing and trading approvals with the respective Stock Exchanges where the shares of the Company are listed.
